sources.entry: osem - Event management tailored to free Software conferences. (Source Code) MIT Ruby/Docker

summary.one_liner: osem is an open source event management tool built for Free and Open Source Software conferences.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly points elsewhere. It describes osem as an event management tool tailored to Free and Open Source Software conferences. It links to a demo and to separate installation and contributing guides, which are not reproduced in the README itself. The README gives no feature list. The awesome-selfhosted listing places it under Conference Management and lists the stack as Ruby with Docker support. Contact is via GitHub issues and the #osem channel on libera.chat IRC.
use_cases: run an open source event website
how_to_run: See the installation guide linked from the README (no commands given in the README itself)
notable: Tailored specifically to Free and Open Source Software conferences
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Conference Management
Installation and contribution guides are maintained separately
caveats: README gives no install commands or feature list; details are in external guides
Scope is focused on FOSS conferences rather than general events
